season.evidence: WebSearch: Ptarmigan Traverse reports show mid-June glacier snow soft and rotten, late Aug melted out at Yang Yang Lakes but more bare ice and crevasses on the glaciers; ascents mostly July. Stored Jul-Sep kept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: July 2025 summit-day segment near Yang Yang Lakes only (starts 10 km from trailhead pin), neither complete nor one-way; no route logged.
July 2020, mid-traverse segment starting well past the trailhead.
52-mile Ptarmigan Traverse through-trip, not a route to this summit.

notes: Only partial or through-traverse tracks exist; none is a trailhead round trip. An Aug 2022 report climbed an east-face snowfield and ledges, possibly a second line.
